title: 6 West Unit Clerk: "The Judge Ordered Zone B Out"

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Command Center Master Board, Floor 1

transcript.speaker: Marisol T. (6 West)
transcript.text: Hi, it's Marisol on 6 West. Sorry, I know you're slammed down there. I need to ask you something before this floor goes crazy.

transcript.speaker: Marisol T. (6 West)
transcript.text: My cousin works for the county. She just texted me that the Judge ordered Zone B out, and the Harbor Bridge is already closed.

transcript.speaker: Marisol T. (6 West)
transcript.text: So that means we're evacuating, right? We're Zone B. Half of 6 West is standing at my desk asking if they should go get their cars now, before the roads lock up.

transcript.speaker: Marisol T. (6 West)
transcript.text: Two of the nursing assistants already have their keys out. One of the patients' daughters heard us talking and she's on the phone with her brother. What do I tell them?

transcript.speaker: Marisol T. (6 West)
transcript.text: Is it true? Are we going?

voiceStyles.Marisol T. (6 West): Woman in her late 20s, fast and a little breathless, worried but trying to stay polite, ward chatter and call bells in the background

instructorNote: This is a red herring. The House Supervisor should stop staff from acting on the rumor and check it with Nueces County OEM. The IC should say that a county zone order does not decide whether the hospital evacuates patients, and that only official information goes to staff and the PIO. If players call OEM at 361-555-0122, read this as the SimCell duty officer: "Negative. There is no Zone B order. The Judge reviews again after the 10:00 advisory. The Harbor Bridge is open and contraflow is still running outbound. Where did you hear that?"

voiceLines.text: Is it true? ... Are we going?
